about.title: About the Astral Radiance set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Astral Radiance is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 27 May 2022. It has 216 cards: 189 in the main set and 27 secret rares. There are also 128 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 189 main set cards), the Master set (317 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 344 cards, adding the 27 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
